snippet.title: Need for Speed Hot Pursuit - Wanted
snippet.description:
If you weren't sure what Need for Speed Hot Pursuit was about, well, this trailer will set the record straight, once and for all. Check it out as cops put the chase on a Porsche 918 Spyder racer.

Pre-order the Limited Edition of the game and get exclusive access to TWO amazing cars, as well as immediate access to FOUR locked vehicles right out of the box.

*Pre-Order Need for Speed Hot Pursuit*
http://bit.ly/dgVvQy

*More Info*
http://hotpursuit.needforspeed.com

*Blog*
http://hotpursuit.needforspeed.com/blog
